verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents concrete deletion/retention controls: CLI and API delete operations, memory expiration dates, and self-hosted deployment giving full data ownership. However, expiration explicitly only suppresses surfacing without deleting underlying data, and there's no documented bulk/account-level erasure workflow, retention policy configuration, or independent verification of deletion behavior. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that delete actually purges data, documented bulk or account-wide deletion/export-then-purge workflow, formal retention policy controls beyond per-memory expiration_date.
